tei:div.tei:p: (oṃ)༄༅// rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma nā ro mkha' spyod ma'i chos skor phyogs gcig tu sdebs pa man ngag rin po che'i gter zhes bya ba sngags 'chang gzungs kyi dpal bas bsgrigs pa bzhugs// ༈ /oṃ swasti sid+dhaṃ/ bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo// ma lus 'gro ba'i sems la khyad par rjes 'gro zhing*// ma lus rgyal ba'i rigs kyi mdzad pas kun 'dul ma// spros bral mkha' dbyings ngang la nam yang mi g.yo ba// bde chen ros gang rgyal ba'i yum chen zhabs pad 'dud// dpal ldan nā ro ta pa nas brgyud pa'i rdo rje rnal 'byor ma sgrub par 'dod pas/ sngon du bsnyen pas mnyes par bya ba dang*/ gzhan don slob ma rjes su bzung ba dang*/ dngos grub kyi las rnams sgrub pa dang gsum las/ dang po ni/ dam tshig dang ldan pa 'dir zhugs shing*/ khyad par du 'phags pa'i dus kyi tshe dben zhing yid du 'ong ba'i gnas su mchod pa dang*/ gtor ma gsum dang*/ yo byad rnams bsags nas/ dmar gtor gcig oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por byin gyis brlabs pa/ namaḥsarba ta thā ga ta bh+yoḥbi shwa mu khe bh+yaḥsarba thā khaṃ ut+ga teḥ s+pha ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ/ gṛh+ṇe daṃ ba liṃ ta ye swā hā/ zhes lan gsum brjod pas bgegs rnams la byin nas/ bgegs dang 'byung po'i tshogs thams cad la mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma rgya chen po 'dis tshim par gyis la/ de bzhin gshegs pa mchod pa'i las brtsams pa la bar du gcod pa ma byed cig dengs shig ces pa dang*/ sum+bha ni brjod cing rol mo'i sgra dang bcas pas bskrad do// las kyi slob mas zhu ba phul ba dang*/ rang nyid rdo rje rnal 'byor ma zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ sku mdog dmar mo bskal pa'i me lta bu'i gzi brjid can/ phyag rgya lnga'i rgyan dang ldan pa/ sna tshogs pad+ma dang nyi ma'i gdan la 'jigs byed dang dus mtshan zhabs kyis mnan pa/ g.yas gri gug dang g.yon thod pa dang kha ṭ+wāṃ ga 'dzin par bsgoms la/

lag pa g.yon pa'i se gol mdun dang phyogs bzhir g.yon skor du/ oṃ sam+bha ni sum+bha hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ gṛh+na gṛh+na hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ gṛh+na pā ya gṛh+na pā ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ a na ya ho bha ga wan badz+ra rā dza hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ g.yas la nye ba'i mtshams nas g.yas skor du sum+bha'i rkang pa re re brjod pas bgegs bskrad do// de nas nang mchod la/ sum+bha ni'i sngags kyi bgegs sbyangs/ swa bhā wa'i sngags kyis stong par bsgom/ stong pa'i ngang las yam̐ las rlung ram̐ las me/ kaṃ kaṃ kaṃ las mi mgo'i sgyed pu gsum gyi steng du āḥlas thod pa dkar po/ de'i steng du shar du oṃ las drin chen/ lhor tram̐ las rak+ta/ nub tu am̐ las byang sems/ byang du kham̐ las klad pa/ dbus su hūm̐ las dri chu/ byang shar du lam̐ las khyi'i sha/ shar lhor mam̐ las ba glang gi sha/ lho nub tu pam̐ las rta'i sha/ nub byang du tam̐ las glang po che'i sha/ dbus su hūm̐ las mi'i sha/ de'i steng du zla ba/ zla ba'i steng du hūm̐ las kha ṭ+wāṃ ga rtse mo mthur la bstan pa hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du yang oṃ/ de'i steng du āḥ de'i steng du hūm̐ bsam/ de nas rlung gis me sbar/ mes thod pa dros/ thod pa'i nang gi rdzas rnams 'od du zhu zhing*/ nyi ma gzhon nu'i 'od zer ltar dmar ser du gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gsum las sku'i 'khor lo/ gsung gi 'khor lo/ thugs kyi 'khor lo'i lha tshogs rnams 'od zer du ma 'phros pas sems can gyi don byas/ tshur 'dus nas/ yi ge de nyid la zhugs par bsams par bya'o// de nas yi ge gsum po thod pa'i nang du lhung ste zhu bas/ oṃ gyis kha dog phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan par gyur/ āḥyis dri phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan par gyur/ hūm̐ gis ro bcud phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan par gyur/ kha ṭ+wāṃ ga las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pas/ kha ṭ+wāṃ ga yang zhu zhing lhung bas/

nus pa'i mthu phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan par bsam zhing*/ ngag tu oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes pa lan gsum brjod/ lag pa g.yon pa'i mtheb srin gyis g.yon bskor du chos 'byung nyis brtsegs bri/ oṃ gsum ma ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtshor gyur par bsam/ de nas byin gyis brlabs pa'i bdud rtsi de/ lag pa g.yas pa dang g.yon pa la gtor nas/ phan tshun gtor zhing mnye ba dang*/ dpral ba/ mgrin pa/ snying ga rnams su dri'i thig le bkod cing*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis byin gyis brlabs pas/ lus dag par byas nas/ gnas dang phyi'i mchod pa rnams la bdud rtsi gtor te/ ye shes chen po las grub pa'i gzhal yas khang chen por/ mchod pa rgya chen po dwangs shing thogs pa med pas gang bar dmigs la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes brjod pas byin gyis brlabs/ de nas skyabs su 'gro ba dang*/ rdo rje sems dpa'i bsgom bzlas byas pas/ sdig pa sbyangs nas/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par gyur cig snyam pa'i byams pa dang*/ sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu dang bral bar gyur cig snyam pa'i snying rje/ sdug bsngal med pa'i bde ba dang dus nam yang mi 'bral bar gyur cig snyam pa'i dga' ba dang*/ bde sdug gi rgyu chags sdang dang bral bar gyur cig snyam pa'i btang snyoms te/ tshad med bzhi dang*/ bdag gzhan sems can thams cad 'khor ba sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho las bsgral la/ rdzogs pa'i byang chub kyi go 'phang la 'god par bya'o// de'i ched du rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma sgom snyam du yun ring du bsam/ rang gi spyi bor nam mkha' la rin po che'i khri dang pad zla'i gdan la/ rang gi bla ma dam pa sku dar la babs pa/ rus pa'i rgyan drug gis brgyan pa/ ḍā ma ru dang kha ṭ+wāṃ ga dang thod pa 'dzin pa bzhugs par bsams la/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bor gyur pa bla ma dam pa la phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o// zhes yang yang brjod cing mos gus drag po byas pas bla ma rang gi lus la thim pas/

rang gi snying gar chos 'byung gru gsum nyis brtsegs kyi lte bar āḥlas zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la bam̐ yig dmar po/ de'i mthar oṃ oṃ oṃ sogs nas swā hā'i bar sngags phreng dmar po g.yon skor du 'khor bar yod pa/ de las 'od zer byung bas lus kyi phyi nang thams cad 'od zer gyis gang ste/ des lus ngag yid gsum gyi sdig sgrib thams cad dag nas lus shel sgong dag pa lta bur gyur pa las rang nyid rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor mar gyur pa ni/ pad+ma dang nyi ma'i steng du zhabs g.yas brkyangs pas dus mtshan ma dmar mo/ g.yon bskum pas 'jigs byed nag po mnan pa/ sku mdog dmar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ spyan gsum ma zhal gyen du phyogs pa/ phyag g.yas rdo rjes mtshan pa'i gri gug thugs kar 'dzin cing*/ g.yon pas khrag gis gang ba'i thod pa steng gi phyogs su bzung nas zhal du gsol pa/ phrag pa g.yon par rdo rjes mtshan pa'i kha ṭ+wāṃ ga la ḍā ma ru dang dril bu 'phyang bzhin pa bsnams pa/ dbu skra nag po sil bur gyur pa/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu brgyan dang*/ skam po lnga bcu'i do shal dang*/ gcer bu rus pa'i rgyan lnga dang ldan pa/ ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs par bsgom/ thugs ka'i sngags phreng las 'od byung ste/ ba spu'i bu ga nas song*/ sems can thams cad la phog pas de thams cad kyi lus ngag yid gsum gyi sgrib pa sbyangs nas rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i skur gyur par bsam mo// tshur 'dus thugs ka'i sngags rnams la thim/ yang 'od 'phros pas 'bar ba'i phyag rgya dang*/ phaiṃ gyis phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' dang*/ dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma thams cad dang*/ sems can thams cad bcom ldan 'das ma'i rnam par spyan drangs shing bdag nyid la thim/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ oṃ yo ga shud+dhaḥsarba dharmaḥyo ga shud+dho3haṃ/ zhes brjod pas gnyis su med par bsams nas rang gi gnas rnams su zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/

lte bar oṃ bam̐ dmar mo rdo rje phag mo/ snying gar ham̐ yoṃ sngon po gshin rje ma/ kha la hri moṃ dkar po rmongs byed ma/ mgo la hriṃ hriṃ ser mo skyod byed ma/ spyi gtsug tu hūm̐ hūm̐ ljang gu skrag byed ma/ yan lag thams cad phaṭa phaṭa dud kha tsaṇ+ḍi ka rnams su bsams la/ de rnams las 'od 'phros sangs rgyas rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa spyan drangs/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i tshogs thams cad kyis bdag la mngon par dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas rigs lngas/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni// de bzhin gshegs kun khrus gsol ltar// lha yi chu ni dag pa yis// de bzhin bdag gis dbang bskur ro// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī hūm̐/ tsakra bi ra s+t+waṃ/ a bhi ṣiñca mi/ badz+ri bha wa a bhi ṣañca hūm̐/ zhes gsungs shing dbang bskur/ spyi gtsug nas rkang mthil yan chad gang dri ma dag dbang thob chu lhag ma yar lud pa las spyi gtsug tu rnam par snang mdzad/ dpral bar mi bskyod pa/ rna ba g.yas pa'i steng du rin chen 'byung ldan/ ltag par 'od dpag med/ rna ba g.yon par don yod grub pa rnams kyis dbu brgyan par bsam/ lha'i sku snang la rang bzhin med pa de nyid la sems rtse gcig mnyam par gzhag go /bskyed pa'i rim pa'o// rdzogs pa'i rim pa bsgom pa'i tshul gsum las/ gsang gnas su chos 'byung dmar po gcig gi nang du dga' ba 'khyil pa g.yon du myur du 'khor bar gcig bsams nas/ de la dmigs pa rtse gcig tu gtad la/ rlung kha sbyor bsgoms pas bde ba'i ting nge 'dzin skye bar 'gyur ro// yang smin mtshams kyi thad ka'i steng gi nam mkhar dga' ba 'khyil pa g.yon du 'khor ba la sems gtad de/ de la yid mnyam par bzhag pas/ mi rtog pa'i ye shes skye bar 'gyur ro// de'ang stong shas che na bde ba'i ting nge 'dzin bsgom zhing*/ bde shas che na stong pa'i ting nge 'dzin bsgom la/

zung du chud par gyur na dga' ba 'khyil pa de nyid snying ga'i bam̐ la bstim te mnyam par bzhag par bya'o// rdzogs pa'i rim pa'o// sngags bzla bar 'dod na/ ngag bzlas ni/ snying ga'i bam̐ gyi mtha' mar sngags kyi phreng ba g.yon skor du 'khor ba'i 'od kyis sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dang dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma thams cad kyi rgyud bskul/ de dag gi ye shes bdag la zhugs pas sdig pa dang sgrib pa dag nas tshe dang bsod nams 'phel bar bsam zhing bzlas so// yid bzlas ni/ bde ba don du gnyer na gsang gnas su/ mi rtog pa 'dod na lte bar/ chos 'byung dmar ser nyis brtsegs kyi grwa bzhir dga' ba 'khyil pa g.yon du 'khor ba re/ dbus su bam̐ yig gi mtha' mar oṃ oṃ oṃ sarba bud+dhā ḍā ki nī ye/ badz+ra war+ṇa nī ye/ badz+ra bai ro tsa nī ye/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ g.yon skor la dmigs la rlung kha sbyar te yid kyis bzlas/ rlung mi thub pa dang dal bus btang zhing*/ yang rlung kha sbyar zhing bzlas/ thun 'jog khar yi ge brgya pa tshar gcig bzlas so// nang mchod kyis rdzas rnams la gtor zhing*/ sum+bhas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las āḥlas ye shes kyi ka pā la yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ las mchod yon nas/ rol mo'i bar/ lha rdzas las grub pa'i mchod pa dpag tu med pa bskyed nas/ ar+ghaṃ nas shab+da āḥhūm̐ gi bar dang*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis byin gyis brlabs/ mdun du dmigs pa'i rten yod dam med kyang rung ste/ sum+bhas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las yam̐ las rlung*/ ram̐ las me/ wam̐ las chu/ lam̐ las sa/ sum̐ las ri'i rgyal po ri rab kyi steng du/ kam̐ las thod pa dkar po shin tu yangs shing rgya che ba bdud rtsi lngas yongs su gang ba'i steng du/ pam̐ las pad+ma/ ram̐ las nyi ma'i steng du hūm̐ las sna tshogs rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las 'phros pa'i 'od kyis rdo rje'i sa gzhi/

rwa ba drwa ba gur bla bre bskal pa'i me lta bu'i ye shes kyi me rab tu 'bar ba'i srung 'khor gyi nang du/ dur khrod chen po brgyad kyis bskor ba'i dbus su/ e e yi yi ge nyis brtsegs pa las chos kyi 'byung gnas nyis brtsegs khog pa stong pa yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du pam̐ las pad+ma/ ram̐ las nyi ma'i steng du bam̐ yig gi mtha' mar oṃ oṃ oṃ gsum nas swā hā'i bar sngags phreng kha dog dmar po/ de 'od du zhu ba las pad+ma dang nyi ma'i steng du rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma zhabs g.yas brkyangs pas dus mtshan ma dmar mo dang*/ zhes pa nas/ sems can thams cad bcom ldan 'das ma'i rnam par spyan drangs shing*/ bcom ldan 'das ma la thim/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ oṃ yo ga shud+dhaḥsarba dharmāḥyo ga shud+dho3haṃ/ gnyis su med par thim/ bcom ldan 'das ma'i lte bar oṃ bam̐ dmar mo nas/ sangs rgyas rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa spyan drangs/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i tshogs thams cad kyis 'di la mngon par dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes pa nas/ chu lhag ma yar lud pa/ spyi gtsug tu rnam par snang mdzad kyis dbu brgyan/ rin po che'i khri yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi steng na pad+ma dang nyi ma dang zla ba'i gdan rnams kyi steng du/ rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i bla ma rnams dang*/ sangs rgyas dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' dang*/ dpa' bo dang*/ rnal 'byor ma dang*/ chos skyong ba'i srung ma thams cad badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra yo gi zhes kun la sbyar la/ ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha ye swā hās mchod yon/ badz+ra pa d+yaṃ gyis zhabs bsil/ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐ gis me tog badz+ra dhu pe āḥhūm̐ gis gdug spos/ badz+ra a lo ke āḥhūm̐ gis mar me/ badz+ra gan+dhe āḥhūm̐ gis dri mchog badz+ra ni wi te āḥhūm̐ gis zhal zas/ badz+ra shab+da āḥhūm̐ gis rol mo dbul/ oṃ badz+ra gaṇ+ḍi ra ṇi ta sogs kyis dbul/ rū pa ka ma gu ṇa pū dzi ta āḥhūm̐ gis gzugs/

shab+da ka ma gu ṇa pu dzi te āḥhūm̐ gis sgra/ gan+dhe ka ma gu ṇa pū dzi te āḥhūm̐ gis dri/ rwa sa ka ma gu ṇa pū dzi te āḥhūm̐ gis ro/ spar+ṣe ka ma gu ṇa pū dzi te āḥhūm̐ gis reg bya dbul bar bya'o// de nas nang gi mchod pa byin gyis brlabs la/ thog mar rang gi rtsa ba'i bla ma la dbul/ rdo rje 'chang*/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/ rdo rje dril bu pa/ ḍā+e gi pa/ an+tar pa/ ti lo/ nā ro pa/ pham thing pa/ bla ma mal/ bla ma sa skya pa chen po/ slob dpon rin po che/ rje btsun rin po che/ bla ma sa skya pa/ chos kyi rgyal po/ bla ma zhang dkon mchog dpal/ bla ma bsod nams dpal/ bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ gzhan yang bla ma brgyud pa rnams la dbul/ oṃ gsum mas rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la gzhan yi dam gang yin gyi sngags kyis dbul/ rang gi lce rtse/ mgrin pa/ snying ga rnams su reg pas/ rang gi lus kyi lha rnams mchod de/ chos skyong srung ma dang*/ yul nyi shu bzhi'i dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma dang*/ 'gro ba rigs drug gi bar gyi sems can rnams la sbyin no// oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis rang gi lce la reg pas bdag bskyed dang*/ mdun bskyed kyi dkyil 'khor gyi lha rnams mnyes par/ bzhad pa'i dbyangs oṃ gsum ma'i sgrar grags par bsam zhing sngags lan gsum brjod/ de nas dpral bar nam mkha' mdzod kyi phyag rgya bcas nas/ na mo chos kyi dbyings kyi byin rlabs dang*/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi thugs rje rnam par dag pa'i byin rlabs dang*/ gsang sngags dang phyag rgya'i mthu dang*/ bdag gi mos pa dang*/ ting nge 'dzin dang*/ smon lam gyi dbang gis 'jig rten gyi khams na bdag pos yongs su ma bzung ba'i mchod pa'i bye brag ji snyed yod pa dang*/ gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang po'i rnam par thar pa las byung ba'i mchod pa'i sprin gyi phung po lta bu bsam gyis mi khyab pa bla ma dang rdo rje rnal 'byor ma dang*/

sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi spyan sngar 'byung bar gyur cig ces brjod nas se gol gdab bo// yang snying gar phyag rgya bcas la/ oṃ sarba bid pū ra pū ra/ su ra su ra/ a warta ya a warta ya hoḥ na maḥs man+ta bud+dha naṃ/ a bhi sma ra ya/ s+pha ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ/ dharmā dha tu a kar ṣa ya/ sa man+ta maṃ/ sarba ta thā ga ta a pa ri sho dha ye/ maṇ+ḍa le/ ma ma pra ni te/ pu n+ya dz+nyā na/ ba len+ta/ sarba ta thā ga ta ba len+ta bhan+dha swa s+tha ba le nā tsa ye swā hā/ yang snying gar phyag rgya bcas la dkrol/ gang gi drin gyis bde chen nyid// skad cig nyid la 'char ba gang*// bla ma rin chen lta bu'i sku// rdo rje can zhabs pad la 'dud// dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma// mkha' 'gro ma yi 'khor los sgyur// ye shes lnga dang sku gsum nyid// 'gro ba skyobs la phyag 'tshal lo// ji snyed rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma// kun tu rtog pa'i 'ching gcod can// 'jig rten bya ba rab 'jug ma// de snyed rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes bstod/ gtor ma nang mchod ltar byin gyis brlabs la/ 'bar ba'i phyag rgya dpral ba'i dbyings su bcas la/ ngag tu phaiṃ zhes brjod/ phaiṃ gyis rdo rje rnal 'byor ma sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dang*/ chos skyong dang 'jig rten skyong ba sogs sems can thams cad kyi ngo bor mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs la/ de nas gtor ma gsol bar bsams nas/ rdo rje thal mo kha phye ste/ oṃ badz+ra a ra li hoḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ badz+ra ḍā ki nī sa ma ya s+t+waṃ dṛ sh+ya hoḥ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes lnga'am bdun gyis phul nas/ ar+ghaṃ nas shab+da'i bar gyis mchod pa dang*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis nang mchod/ dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma sogs nas/ de snyed rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// lha mo tshad ma dam tshig tshad ma dang*// des gsung tshig gang tshad ma'i mchog yin pas// bden pa des ni lha mo de dag rnams// bdag cag rjes su 'dzin pa'i rgyur gyur cig

/sems can thams cad bde gyur cig /sems can thams cad skyon med pa// gang gi lam gyis grol gyur pa// des ni sangs rgyas nyid thob shog /bkra shis gang zhig chos kyi dbyings las byung gyur cing*// he ru ka dpal 'jigs byed rgyal po 'bar ba'i sku// shes rab phag mo'i pad+mor rdo rjes rol mdzad pa// bkra shis des ni bde mchog la gnas bkra shis shog /yi ge brgya pa brjod cing bzod par gsol/ gnyis pa chos skyong dang*/ gsum pa mkha' 'gro spyi gtor gyis dbul lo// de nas tshogs kyi yo byad rnams gtor ma ltar byin gyis brlabs nas phud bla ma dang lha rnams la dbul zhing*/ gtor ma la'ang so so'i sngags brjod pas phul nas/ dam tshig drangs la phud nang mchod kyi skabs ltar mchod nas/ rang rdo rje rnal 'byor mar dmigs pa'i lte ba nas gtum mo'i me sbar ba'i me lce'i khrod du snying gar bla ma dang sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs dang*/ lte bar 'jig rten pa'i tshogs thams cad dmigs pas/ rang gi lag pa g.yon pa'i mthil du pad+ma 'dab ma lnga pa bsgom pa'i lte bar oṃ bam̐ mdun phyogs nas brtsams pa'i gdan rnams la rim pa bzhin ham̐ yoṃ hriṃ moṃ/ hriṃ hriṃ/ hūm̐ hūm̐/ phaṭa phaṭa/ bkod pa rnams dpa' mo drug tu dmigs la mchod par bsam zhing*/ thog mar zhu ba'i rdzas dang*/ de nas gong bu'i rdzas kyis mchod pas mnyes par bsam zhing*/ lag pa gnyis phan tshun mnye'o// de nas lag pa g.yon pas dpral ba/ mgrin pa/ snying gar reg pas/ dpal mo de rnams rang gi lus la thim par bsams la/ lag pa g.yon pas thog mar phud kyi bla ma dang yi dam mchod nas/ de nas hoṃ khung bsam par phul nas/ lus thams cad mnyes par bsam zhing bza'o// de nas lhag ma/ oṃ kha kha khā hi khā hi/ u tsiṣ+ṭa ba liṃ ta bhak+ṣa si swā hās lhag ma la dbang ba'i 'byung po rnams la sbyin no// rdo rje'i glu dang bkra shis kyi tshigs su bcad pa gang yin gyi mthar/

bkra shis gang zhig chos kyi dbyings nas byung gyur zhing*// zhes sogs brjod/ sems can thams cad bde gyur cig /ces sogs ci shes pa'i bsngo ba dang*/ 'chi tshe mgon dang dpa' bo ma tshogs kyis// me tog rgyal mtshan gdugs sogs thogs nas kyang*// rol mo glu dang sgra snyan sogs mchod nas// mkha' la spyod pa'i gnas su khrid par shog /ces dang*// lha mo tshad ma dam tshig tshad ma dang*// zhes sogs kyis bden pa'i stobs brjod/ nyes ltung bshags pa'i bsam pas/ yi ge brgya pa mang du brjod pa'i mthar/ ma 'byor pa dang nyams pa dang*// gang yang bdag rmongs blo yis ni// bgyis pa dang ni bgyid stsal ba// de kun mgon pos bzod par mdzod// zhes bzod par gsol la/ mdun bskyed kyi lha la mchod pa dang*/ bstod pa byas nas/ bdag gi sdig pa dang sgrib pa dang dam tshig gi nyes pa dang*/ bar du gcod pa dang mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad zhi ba dang*/ tshe dang bsod nams dpal dang 'byor pa dang*/ sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ 'chi ba'i tshe mkha' la spyod pa'i gnas su khrid pa dang*/ mthar thug bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rdo rje 'chang chen po'i go 'phang thob par mdzad du gsol/ zhes lan gsum gsol ba btab nas/ de nas mdun bskyed kyi rten yod na brtan bzhugs bya/ med na gtor ma'i yon dang bcas pa la/ oṃ khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzod// rjes su mthun pa'i dngos grub stsol// sangs rgyas yul du gshegs nas kyang*// slar yang 'byon par mdzad du gsol// zhes pa dang yi ge brgya pa'i mthar/ badz+ra muḥ zhes brjod pas ye shes pa gshegs su gsol/ dam tshig pa rang la bsdu/ spyod lam gyi rnal 'byor ni/ rang gi gnas gsum bsrung zhing*/ go cha drug gis kyang btab la rang dang snang ba rnal 'byor ma'i skur dmigs la/ lha la lhas mchod par bsams pa sku'i dga' ba/

de'ang sgyu ma lta bu'i sku dang*/ bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i ngang las ma g.yos par dran par bya ba thugs kyi dga' ba/ sgra ci grags pa thams cad sngags kyi bzlas par bya ba gsung gi dga' ba ste/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma phyag mtshan med pa'i rnam pa dang*/ dga' ba gsum dang ma bral ba'i sgo nas bskor ba byed pa dang*/ phyag 'tshal ba dang*/ chos 'chad pa la sogs pa dge bas dus 'da' bar bya'o// nyal ba'i rnal 'byor ni/ bskyed rim ltar nyal na seṅge'i khri'i steng du rang rdo rje rnal 'byor ma phyag mtshan med pa'i rnam pa gsal btab la/ steng gi nam mkhar rang gi bla ma rnam par snang mdzad mi bskyod pa dbye ba med par bzhugs pa la/ rang gi lus ngag yid gsum phul ba'i bsam pas nyal bar bya'o// ldang ba'i rnal 'byor yang*/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma phyag mtshan med pa'i skur ldang bar bya'o// rdzogs pa'i rim pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i ngang la nyal ba ni/ snying ga'i sngags phreng las 'od 'phros pas khams gsum thams cad 'od zer gyis gang*/ de nas gzugs med khams stod kyi cha la/ gzugs khams bar gyi cha la/ 'dod khams smad kyi cha la/ rang yang sngags dang zla ba la/ zla ba sngags la/ de bam̐ la/ de'ang thig le nā da dkar dmar du gyur te/ chu la rlabs thim pa ltar/ de'ang mi dmigs par bsams la/ de'i ngang du shes pa glod de nyal bar bya'o// ldang ba ni ḍā ma ru'i sgra oṃ gsum ma'i sgra grags pas gnyid sad par bya ste/ snga ma ltar phyag mtshan med pa'i skur ldang ngo*// bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i rnal 'byor ni/ rdzogs pa'i rim pa'i ngang la nyal ba dang*/ ldang ba ltar spyod lam la 'jug pa'i don du bsgom pa yin no// bla ma sa skya pa chen po nas/ nyal dang lngang dang bdud rtsi myong*// tshad med bla ma bdag lhar bskyed// 'gro ba dag pa'i rnal 'byor dang*// dpa' bo dpa' mos byin gyis brlabs// ngag bzlas yid bzlas gnyis gcig yin// bsam gyis mi khyab rnal 'byor dang*// spyod lam gyi ni rnal 'byor te// de ltar rnal 'byor bcu gcig go

/zhes gsungs so// de lta bu'i rnal 'byor la rtag tu gnas nas/ rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma nyid kyis rjes su bzung nas/ mkha' la spyod pa'i go 'phang myur du thob ste/ go 'phang de la brten nas rdo rje 'chang chen po'i dngos grub kyang thob par 'gyur ba nyid do// de lta bu'i tshul gyis 'bum phrag bzhi la sogs pa'i bsnyen pa bya'o// ༈ /gnyis pa gzhan don du slob ma rjes su bzung ba ni/ chos kyi tshul 'di la zhugs shing 'di nyid kyi bsnyen pa sngon du song ba'i gang zag rang gzhan la byin rlabs dang*/ dngos grub don du gnyer bas/ dus bzang po la gnas dben zhing yid du 'ong bar/ dri bzang po dang bcas pa'i ba byung gis byugs pa'i gzhi tshon dmar pos yongs su bsgyur ba la re khā dkar pos phyi'i mu khyud dang bcas pa'i chos 'byung nyis brtsegs bris pa'i steng du/ ka pā la bdud rtsi'i sbyar ba'i chang gis yongs su gang ba bzhag nas/ de'i steng du sin+dhu ra'i maṇ+ḍal dpe ris bzhin gser gyi thur mas bris pa'i dbus su/ dri ma med pa'i ting lo chung du bzhag pa'i steng du/ dar ram lwa ba dmar po la sogs pa'i dar khang mdzes par phub pa'i khor yug tu chu gnyis sngon du 'gro ba'i mchod pa lnga dang*/ shin tu zhim pa'i bza' ba dang*/ btung ba dang 'bras bu la sogs pas yongs su bskor zhing gtor ma gsum dang*/ nang mchod la sogs pa tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i skabs dang mthun par bsam zhing*/ gzungs thag gis dkris pa'i rdo rje dang*/ dung chos dang bcas pa'i bum pa bcud rnams kyis gang ba gcig kyang bshams la/ zhu 'bul ba nas mdun bskyed mchod pa bstod pa rnams gong ltar byas la/ de nas bum pa sum+bhas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las pad+ma dang ram̐ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du bh+rūm̐ las rin po che'i bum pa yangs shing rgya che ba/ lha rdzas kyi na bzas mgul bcings shing*/

dpag bsam gyi shing gis kha brgyan pa'i bum pa bskyed pa'i nang du/ rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma bskyed nas/ ye shes pa gzhug pa'i bar sgrub thabs ltar byas la/ phyi nang gi mchod pa dang bstod pa byas nas gzungs thag bzung ste sngags gzungs thag la brten nas bum pa'i nang du song bas rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i thugs brgyud bskul nas ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgyun zags nas bum pa gang bar bsam zhing rje btsun ma'i sngags gang 'grub pa dang*/ sum+bha'i sngags dang*/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐/ zhes ci rigs pa bzlas nas/ slar yang mchod cing bstod nas/ dung chos kyi chu blugs pas lha'i sku'ang 'od du zhu nas bum pa'i chu dang ro gcig tu gyur par bsam mo// de nas bdag nyid 'jug cing dbang blang bar bya ste/ 'og nas 'byung ba'i cho ga'i ngo bo maṇ+ḍal phul/ gang gi drin gyis bde chen nyid// ces pa nas/ cha yis kyang ni spyad du gsol// zhes pa'i bar rnams yin no// gtor ma btang*/ tshogs kyi 'khor lo byas la/ lhag ma'i gtor ma btang*/ slob ma dbang thob pa'i dam tshig ma nyams pa/ khrus byas pa rnams chang gis chos 'byung gi rnam pa bris pa'i steng du 'dug tu bcug la/ maṇ+ḍal 'bul du bcug ste/ khyed rnams sems can thams cad kyi don du sku bzhi'i ye shes lnga dang ldan pa'i rdo rje 'chang thob par bya ba'i ched du/ zab cing mchog tu gyur pa'i chos zhu snyam pa'i bsam pa mdzod la gsan 'tshal/ 'dir bcom ldan 'das ma rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i byin rlabs sgrub par byed pa yin/ 'di la 'jug pa dang dbang bskur ba gnyis yod pa las/ de las dkyil 'khor du 'jug par byed pa la phyi rdzas dang yo byad/ nang sems can la chags pa dang zhen pa mi byed par/ lha dang bla ma la mos pa khyad par can dgos te/ spyod 'jug las/ chags pa'i phyir dang rnyed sogs la// sred pas 'jig rten mi spong ste// de bas 'di dag yongs spangs la// mkhas pas 'di ltar spyad par bya// zhes gsungs pa yin/

bla ma dang rdo rje rnal 'byor ma gnyis su med pa la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dpag tu med pas bskor ba/ bdag la rtse gcig tu dgongs pa mngon sum lta bur bzhugs pa sgom mdzod la/ maṇ+ḍal gling bzhi ri rab nyi zla lha dang mi'i yo byad phun sum tshogs pas gang ba phul nas/ dam pa'i chos ston par gsol ba gdab snyam pa mdzod la lad mo mdzod/ gang gi drin gyis bde chen nyid// skad cig nyid la 'char ba gang*// bla ma rin chen lta bu'i sku// rdo rje can zhabs pad la 'dud// sangs rgyas kun gyi rang bzhin sku// slob dpon la ni bdag skyabs mchi// dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma// mkha' 'gro ma yi 'khor los sgyur// ye shes lnga dang sku gsum nyid// 'gro ba skyobs la phyag 'tshal lo// skye dang rga dang 'chi ba yi// chu srin la sogs 'jig rung ba'i// 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho las 'don pa'i// mgon khyod bdag la dgongs su gsol// bde ba chen po bdag 'tshal bas// byang chub chen po'i lam bstan pas// dam tshig de nyid bdag la stsol// byang chub sems kyang bdag la stsol// sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te// skyabs gsum dag kyang bdag la stsol// thar pa chen po grong mchog tu// mgon pos bdag ni gzhug tu gsol// dpa' bo dpa' mos dbang phyug mo// phag mo he ru ka nyid dang*// gsang ba'i gnas sogs rnam par dag /bdag lus gnas par mdzad du gsol// zhes gsol ba lan gsum btab nas/ rdo rje rnal 'byor mas khyed rang gi gdong bcings par mos pa mdzod/ me tog gi phreng ba yang gtad/ sum+bhas bsangs/ dpral ba/ mgrin pa/ snying ga rnams su thig le byas la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis byin gyis brlabs/ khyed rang gi snying ga'i nang du kun rdzob byang chub sems kyi ngo bo zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ don dam byang chub sems kyi ngo bo rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa bsgoms la/ de rnal 'byor mas khyed rang gi snying gar bzhag nas byin gyis brlabs par sgoms shig

oṃ sarba yo ga tsit+ta uta pa ta ya mi/ su ra te sa ma ya s+t+waṃ ho sid+dhi badz+ra ya tha su khaṃ/ spyi bor rdo rje bzhag nas dam la 'jog par mos pa mdzod cig deng khyod rnal 'byor ma'i rigs su zhugs kyis/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis gsang chen dam pa 'di/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dkyil 'khor du ma zhugs pa rnams kyi mdun du smra bar mi bya ste/ ma dad pa rnams la yang ma yin no// bcom ldan 'das ma'i thugs ka nas spros pa'i lha mo rnams kyis khyed rnams khrid nas bcom ldan 'das ma'i drung du bzhag par mos pa mdzod/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ don dran bzhin pas yan lag bdun pa'i sgo nas byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed snyam pa mdzod la rjes su zlos pa mdzod cig dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi// zhes sogs nas/ 'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog /lan gsum brjod/ khyad par du sdig pa dang dam tshig gi nyes pa sogs bshags snyam pa mdzod la lad mo mdzod cig bla ma dang rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma dang sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba tshe thog ma med pa nas las dang nyon mongs pa'i dbang du gyur pas/ lus ngag yid gsum gyi sgo nas sdig pa mi dge ba'i las bgyis pa dang*/ bgyid du stsal ba dang*/ bgyis pa la rjes su yi rang ba dang*/ so sor thar pa'i sdom pa dang 'gal ba dang*/ byang chub sems dpa'i bslab bya dang 'gal ba dang*/ rig pa 'dzin pa'i dam tshig dang 'gal ba dang*/ khyad par du bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi lha la ma gus pa dang*/ mchod pa dang gtor ma la ma brtson pa dang*/ bsnyen pa dang sgrub pa la g.yel ba la sogs pa sdig pa dang*/ sgrib pa dang*/ nyes pa dang ltung ba'i tshogs ci mchis pa thams cad mthol lo bshags so// mi 'chab bo// mi sbed do// slan chad kyang gcod cing sdom par bgyid lags so// zhes lan gsum brjod do// rigs lnga spyi dang khyad par gyi sdom pa blang snyam pas rjes zlos mdzod cig

sras bcas sangs rgyas thams cad dang*// zhes sogs nas/ sems can mya ngan 'das la 'god// zhes lan gsum brjod do// de nas khyad par gyi dam tshig rnams kyang blangs la bsrung snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod la rjes su bzlas pa mdzod cig sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun la// rtag par bdag ni skyabs su mchi// rnal 'byor gsang sngags mkha' 'gro ma// 'khor lo gsum gyi bdag nyid can// kun la bdag ni skyabs su mchi// dpa' bo dpa' mo dbang lha mo// byang chub sems dpa' bdag nyid che// khyad par du yang slob dpon la// rtag par bdag ni skyabs su mchi// dpal ldan khrag 'thung sogs dpa' bo// rnal 'byor ma dang snang mdzad sogs// byang chub sems dpa' dpag med pa// thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol// bdag gis dus 'di nas bzung ste// ji srid gnyis med la gnas pa// de yi tshangs spyod gnyis med par// nyi shu rtsa gnyis legs par bsrung*// zhes lan gsum brjod pas/ dam tshig dang sdom pa ma lus pa thob pa yin/ da byin gyis brlabs pa sgrub pa yin pas/ bcom ldan 'das ma'i thugs ka nas 'phros pa'i 'od zer gyis khyed rang gi lus kyi phyi nang gang zhing khyab par byas pas/ sdig sgrib thams cad dag nas 'od 'dus lte ba'i nang du chos 'byung nyis brtsegs kyi nang du bam̐ yig gi mthar/ oṃ oṃ oṃ nas swā hā'i bar de las 'od 'phros sogs nas/ mngon rtogs bzhin yan lag thams cad la phaṭa phaṭa dud kha tsaṇ+ḍi ka rnams yod par bsgoms la/ bla ma dang rnal 'byor ma gnyis su med pa la gsol ba gdab pa'i tshig 'di skad lad mo mdzod/ slob dpon khyed rnams kyis/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las thams cad kyi dngos grub dang*/ 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dngos grub stsal zhing brtan par mdzad du gsol/ zhes lan gsum gsol ba btab/ dkyil 'khor gyi dbus kyi ting lo sbar la/

de rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs dang*/ ye shes thams cad gcig tu bsdus pa de nyid kyi thugs kar rdo rje rnal 'byor ma mthe bong gi tshad dang mnyam pa/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma rje btsun ma nyid kyis khyed rang gi khar sbyin par sgoms shig byas la ting lo mid du gzhug mgrin pa dang snying ga nas dmar hril gyis song nas/ lus kyi dbus su yar khyug mar khyug mang du byas nas/ lte ba'i chos 'byung nyis brtsegs kyi dbus su/ bam̐ dang 'dres pa las lte ba'i rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sku zhabs g.yas brkyang bas dus mtshan ma dmar mo mnan ces pa nas/ mngon rtogs bzhin ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'i bar/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sku bde ba chen po nas yongs su gang bas gar mdzad/ nang gi chos 'byung gi grwa bzhi dang*/ phyi'i lha mo'i smin mtshams kyi thad ka rnams su dga' ba 'khyil pa dmar po g.yon phyogs su myur du 'khor bar bsam/ de'i tshe mdun gyi rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma dang*/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi sngags kyi sgra drag tu bsgrags pas phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bskul nas/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i rnam par gyur pa/ khyed rang rnams la thim pas/ khyed rang rnams kyi lus ngag yid gsum dang gnyis su med par byin gyis brlabs par sgoms shig sgrub pa'i grogs rnams kyis gu gul gyi dud pa dang*/ rol mo'i sgra byed du gzhug go /oṃ oṃ oṃ nas swā hā'i bar bya/ khyed rang gi spyi bor rdo rje bzhag oṃ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra zhes brtan par sgoms shig de la byin gyis brlabs pa'i nyams sems kyi spyod yul du sdang bas rnam pa 'gyur ba cung zad zhig mnyam par bzhag khyed kyi sems dang lte ba yi rdo rje rnal 'byor ma yin pa ste/ de ltar byin gyis brlabs kyi sgo nas gsal bar byas pa yin no// de lta bu'i bde ba de phyis kyang ma brjed par gyis shig

de nas me tog gi phreng ba de dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo'i thugs kar phul bar bsgoms la/ oṃ pra tīts+tsha badz+ra hoḥ dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su dor cig bcom ldan 'das mas me tog gi phreng ba de nyid sngags kyi phreng bar byin gyis brlabs nas/ khyed rang gi spyi bor bzhag nas byin gyis brlabs par mos pa mdzod/ oṃ pra ti gṛh+na s+t+waṃ i maṃ/ sa twa ma hā ba la oṃ/ me tog phreng ba slob ma la gtad/ de nas bla mas/ oṃ nai tra a pa hā ra pa tra laṃ hrīḥ zhes brjod la/ gdong g.yogs phye la/ dur khrod chen po brgyad kyi dbus su chos kyi 'byung gnas dmar po nyis brtsegs kyi steng du/ pad+ma dang nyi ma'i gdan gyi steng du 'jigs byed dus mtshan gyi steng du rdo rje rnal 'byor ma nyi ma bye ba'i 'od dang mtshungs pa/ gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa/ rus pa'i rgyan cha lnga dang ldan pa gcig dngos su mthong bar bsgom/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor du zhugs shing mthong ba yin no// 'jug pa'i cho ga'o// de nas dbang blang ba'i phyir/ maṇ+ḍal phul nas/ byang chub rdo rje sangs rgyas la// mchod chen ji ltar stsal ba ltar// bdag kyang bskyab pa'i don gyi phyir// dbang bskur dam pa stsal du gsol// zhes lan gsum gsol ba btab/ bla ma rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i mdun du rin po che'i khri'i steng du khyed rang yang rdo rje rnal 'byor mar gsal bar bsgoms pa'i steng du/ gdugs dkar po gser gyi yu ba can phub cing*/ khor yug thams cad du mchod pa'i sprin gyis bskor ba la/ dkyil 'khor gyi dbus kyi gtso bo'i thugs ka nas/ khro bo dang khro mo spros pas bgegs bskrad/ lha dang lha mo'i tshogs spros pas khyed rang rnams la mchod/ sems dpa' dang sems ma'i tshogs 'phros pa rnams kyis bkra shis kyi tshigs su bcad pa brjod/ de bzhin gshegs pa dang rig ma'i tshogs 'phros pas/

sangs rgyas thams cad kyi chus bkang ba'i bum pas khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bo nas blugs shing*/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni// de bzhin gshegs kun khrus gsol ltar// lha yi chu ni dag pa yis// de bzhin bdag gis dbang bskur ro// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa mā shrī ye hūm̐/ tsakra bi ra s+t+waṃ a bhi ṣiñca mi/ badz+ri bha wa a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐/ zhes mgrin gcig tu gsungs shing dbang bskur bar sgoms shig dngos su yang gtor/ spyi gtsug nas rkang pa'i mthil yan chad gang*/ dri ma thams cad dag dbang thams cad thob/ chu lhag ma yar lud pa las/ spyi gtsug tu rnam par snang mdzad/ dpral bar mi bskyod pa/ rna ba g.yas pa'i steng du rin chen 'byung ldan/ ltag par 'od dpag med/ rna ba g.yon par don yod grub pa rnams kyis dbu brgyan par sgoms shig oṃ a badz+ra mu ku ṭa a bhi ṣiñca mi su ra s+t+waṃ a haṃ/ zhes brjod nas dngos su'ang dbu rgyan bcing ngo*// de nas rje btsun ma 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad kyis mgrin gcig tu khams gsum chos kyi rgyal por rab tu gnas par bya'o// oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ye swā hā/ zhes gsungs shing me tog gtor nas/ rdo rje slob dpon du dbang bskur bar sgoms shig rol mo'i sgra yang bya'o// da khyod rang thal mo sbyar ba'i bar du bgrang phreng bzung nas/ bla ma dang bcom ldan 'das ma tha dad med pa'i thugs ka nas/ sngags kyi phreng ba 'phros pas/ khyed rang gi snying ga'i bam̐ gyi mtha' mar g.yon skor du bkod pas/ rje btsun ma dang*/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis gsang sngags kyi byin rlabs khyed rang la zhugs par sgoms shig oṃ gsum ma lan gsum gyis rjes zlos byas pa'i mthar/ bcom ldan bdag la stsal lags kyis// bcom ldan bdag la byin gyis rlobs// lan gsum brjod/ phreng ba bla ma'i phyag tu phul/ phreng ba slob ma'i spyi bor bzhag la/

phreng ba de sngags kyi ngo bor byin gyis brlabs nas/ khyed rang la byin par mos pa gyis shig bcom ldan 'di la stsal lags kyis// bcom ldan 'di la byin gyis rlobs// zhes lan gsum/ phreng ba slob ma la gtad/ sngags kyi rjes su gnang ba thob pa yin no// de nas lag pa g.yon pa'i srin lag gis/ sin+dhu ra'i dkyil 'khor nas rdul blangs nas/ dpral ba/ mgrin pa/ snying ga gsum du byugs pas sku'i dngos grub thams cad zhugs pa yin/ de ltar byas pas lus kyi dri ma dag bum pa'i dbang thob pa yin/ de nas bla ma dang bcom ldan 'das ma tha dad med pa las byung ba'i byang sems dkar dmar maṇ+ḍal gyi 'og gi thod pa'i bdud rtsi rje btsun ma nyid kyis khyed rang gi snying ga'i sgor byin zhing 'thung bas/ rtsa thams cad ye shes kyi bdud rtsis gang bar bsgoms/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes brjod la 'thung du gzhug des ngag gi dri ma dag gsang ba'i dbang thob pa yin no// de nas bla ma'i srin lag gis sin+dhu ra'i rdul blangs te/ rdo rje rnal 'byor mas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi byang chub kyi sems kyi thig le khyed rang gi bha gar blugs cing lte ba man chad thig les gang bas dga' ba'i ye shes skyes par bsgom byas la/ gsang gnas su reg de bzhin du lte ba dang snying ga man chad gang bas mchog dga'i ye shes skyes par bsgom/ snying ga nas mgrin pa yan chad byang chub kyi sems kyis yongs su bltams/ de dga' bral gyi dga' ba'i ye shes yin byas la/ mgrin pa dang*/ de las kyang byang chub kyi sems gyen du bskyed de/ spyi gtsug man chad lus la khyab pas lhan cig skyes pa'i dga' ba mngon du byas pa yin/ chos kyi sku'i rtogs pa rgyud la skyes pa yin no snyam du bsgom la/ 'di skad brjod cing*/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu ra ga na badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ de ltar byas pas yid kyi dri ma dag

shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob pa yin/ lus mnyam bzhag sgal tshigs drang por bgyis la/ gang la yang yid 'dzin pa med par gzhog cig dngos po med pa'i chos nyid chos// nam mkha' lta bu dri ma med// stong nyid ye shes rdo rje yi// stong pa nyid du rnam par bsgom// yid gang la'ang 'dzin pa med par cung zad cig mnyam par zhog cig byas la mnyam par 'jog tu gzhug des lus ngag yid gsum gyi dri ma dag dbang bzhi yongs su rdzogs par thob pa yin no// dbang thams cad thob pa'i bka' drin gyi yon du maṇ+ḍal dang*/ lus longs spyod thams cad yid kyis phul la/ 'di skad du lad mo mdzod cig deng nas brtsams te bdag bran du// khyed la bdag ni 'bul lags na// khyed kyis slob mar bzung ba dang*// cha yis kyang ni spyad du gsol// lan gsum brjod/ khyed rang gi ngag dang sems dang lus rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i rang bzhin yin pa la/ da phyin byin gyis brlabs pa'i sgo nas/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i ngo bor gsal bar byas shing*/ byin gyis brlabs pas khyed rang gi lus ngag yid gsum thams cad rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i ngo bo yin/ byin gyis brlabs pa'i rgyun mi nyams par bya ba'i don du nyin zhag la'ang yi dam du ma chag par byed pa/ dam tshig dang sdom pa ma nyams pa byed dgos so// tshogs gsog par 'dod na yar ngo'i tshes bcu/ sgrib pa dag par 'dod na mar ngo'i tshes bcu la 'di nyid kyi bsgom bzlas yun ring sgrubs shig tshogs kyi 'khor los mchod cing bsgrubs nas/ bsod nams rab kyis tshe 'di nyid la 'grub ste/ rnal 'byor ma mi mo'i gzugs la brten te/ rnal 'byor pa la mkha' spyod la sogs par byin gyis brlabs par mdzad de/ de'i rtags ni/ mi mo gang zhig sha dang mig dang skra la sogs pa dmar ser du 'jug cing*/ dpral ba na sha'i ri mo dga' ba 'khyil pa yod pa de lta bu dang 'phrad nas/ de ni rdo rje rnal 'byor ma yin pa'i rtags te/

de la g.yon nas bskor ba la sogs pa'i sgo nas mchod pa dang bstod pas mnyes par bya zhing*/ gsol ba btab na tshe 'di nyid la mkha' spyod du khyer ro// gal te de lta bu'i tshul gyis grub par ma gyur na/ rnal 'byor pa bsod nams 'bring po yin te/ des sin+dhu ra'i sgrub pa'i tshul gyis bsnyen pa 'bum phrag bzhi bskyal la/ des sin+dhu ra'i bsgrub pa brtsams te/ laṅka li ya zhes bya ba'i shing sbubs can zhig yod de/ bod du rgod pas btub gsungs so// sor bzhi'am sor brgyad pa cig tshes bcu'am tshes brgyad gang yang rung ba gcig la blangs te/ rnal 'byor ma la mchod pa bya zhing*/ de lag tu thogs la sngags stong rtsa brgyad bzlas so// de nas yang yar gyi tshes bcu gcig la sin+dhu ra'i phye ma btsags shing*/ gser gyi smyu gus chos 'byung dang*/ sngags dang*/ dga' ba 'khyil pa bris te/ rten de la mchod cing bstod la bzlas nas/ gsol btab la/ sin+dhu ra bsdus te/ sngags bzlas pas shing gi sbugs bkang la/ steng 'og gi bu ga la cha'am/ spra tshil gyis bkag la/ sgrub pa'i grogs mchog sum+bha ni bzlas pa cig dang*/ dur khrod du phyin la/ sin+dhu ra dang shing de dur khrod kyi sa brkos pa'i nang du gzhug la/ de'i steng du bdag nyid bsdad nas bzlas pa ci nus byas la/ sa phyogs de bsrung ba byas la bzhag la/ de nas bdag nyid bsam gtan gyi khang par log la/ ji lta ba bzhin du bzla'o// de nas tshes bcu gcig nas bzung nas bco lnga'i bar du nam sum cha dur khrod du phyin la bzla'o// de nas bcu drug nas nyi shu'i bar du ni nam phyed phyed du bzla'o// de nas nyi shu gcig nas nyi shu bzhi'i bar du ni sum gnyis sum gnyis bzlas so// nyi shu lnga'i ni mtshan thog thag tu bzlas so// skya rengs dang po shar ba dang sin+dhu ra bton nas bsam gtan gyi khang par song la/ yum rdo rje phag mo la mchod cing bstod de gsol ba btab la/

de nas nang ma re bzhin bzlas bsgom dang*/ mchod bstod la sogs pa bsgrub pa ji lta ba bzhin byed cing*/ bdag nyid kyi dpral bar sin+dhu ras dga' ba 'khyil pa bri zhing*/ bdag nyid sa la 'dug pa'i bang tshod dang mnyam pa'i khru do pa'i sba dbyug gcig la/ sum+bha ni mang du bzlas pas rnal 'byor pa'i dbyug pa byin gyis brlabs pa thogs nas/ nang ma re re bzhin du sin+dhu ra'i ri mos dpral bar dga' ba 'khyil pa bri zhing*/ yul thams cad du 'khyams par bya'o// 'khyams pas yum rdo rje phag mo dang 'phrad par 'gyur te/ mi mo la sogs pa gang 'phrad pa'i dus su de'i rtags ni sin+dhu ra'i ri mo de dpral ba la 'phos na de rnal 'byor ma yin pas de la mchod pa dang*/ bsnyen bkur byas te gsol ba btab pas mkha' la spyod pa la sogs pa'i dngos grub ster bar 'gyur ro// de ltar bsgrubs kyang ma 'grub na rnal 'byor pa bsod nams tha mar gyur pa yin pas rje btsun ma la mos par byas nas/ shi nas bar dor rje btsun mas zhal bstan nges par rjes su 'dzin par 'gyur ro// zhes gsungs so// de rnams kyi sgo nas rje btsun ma'i byin gyis brlabs pa grub pa yin pas/ phyag gsum 'tshol la bka' drin che gsungs/ tshogs nang mchod ltar byin gyis brlabs/ phud bla ma dang*/ lha la phul ba nas nyal ba'i rnal 'byor sogs gong du bstan pa bzhin du nyams su blang ngo*// de dag gis ni gzhan don du slob ma rjes su bzung ba bstan zin to// ༈ /gsum pa dngos grub bsgrub pa mang du yod kyang*/ sngags kyi nus pa dbyung ba'i phyir sbyin sreg bya ba'i tshul ni/ grangs kyi bsnyen pa bzhi 'bum mam/ 'bum phrag gnyis sam/ tha ma 'bum phrag gcig bzlas pa'i rnal 'byor pas/ sa'i cho ga rgyas bsdus gang yang rung ba byas pa'i sar las bzhi ka'i thab khung brtsigs te/ chos 'byung gi dbyibs can rtse mo bdag la bstan pa rgyar khru gang ba/

dpangs su khru phyed pa/ kha dog dmar por byugs pa'i lte bar rdo rje dmar po bri/ kha khyer sor gsum phyir dor ba gri gug mu ran sor gsum brtsigs pa la rdo rje'i phreng ba bri/ las dang mthun pa'i bud shing brtsigs/ g.yon phyogs su chu gnyis sngon du 'gro ba'i mchod pa lnga dang*/ me lha'i gtor ma gcig g.yas su yam shing*/ mar khu chang bzang po la bdud rtsi ril bu sbyar ba'am/ gang yang rung ba'i sha dum bur gtub pa/ til/ zho/ 'o ma/ bu ram/ ka ra/ sbrang rtsi rnams sbyar ba'i zas mchog dūr+wa/ ku sha gsung mod/ phyag len la/ 'bras/ so ba/ nas/ sran ma/ gro/ dūr+wa/ ku sha rnams bshams/ mdun du rdo rje dril bu/ nang mchod dgang gzar blugs rnams dgod/ bdag bskyed bzlas pa dang bcas pa sngon du song ba'am/ mdun bskyed la phyi nang yid 'byung gi mchod pa bstod pa rnams sngon du song bas/ rang chas gos dkar po bgos la/ kha shar du bltas te/ sems can thams cad kyi spang bya mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad zhi bar bya ba'i bsam pas/ me mar thogs te/ sum+bha ni zlos pas thab la bskor nas/ oṃ badz+ra dz+wa la raṃ gyis me sbar bas/ mar blugs gzar gsum gyis me gso/ nang mchod kyis mchod rdzas rnams la gtor zhing*/ sum+bha nis bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las ye shes kyi ka pā la yangs shing rgya che ba rnams su oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhu ba las byung ba'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me tog bdug spos/ mar me/ dri/ zhal zas/ rol mo'i sgra bsam gyis mi khyab pa/ oṃ ar+ghaṃ nas shab+da'i bar āḥhūm̐/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis byin gyis brlabs/ nang mchod kyis bsregs rdzas la gtor zhing*/ sum+bha ni dang*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ shrī swā hā/ oṃ dz+rīṃ swā hā/ oṃ ku ru ku ru swā hā/ swa bhā was stong par sbyangs pa'i ngang las ā las thod pa yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhu ba las byung ba'i bsreg rdzas/

yam shing*/ mar/ bdud rtsi lnga/ sha lnga/ zas mchog 'bras/ so ba/ nas/ sran ma/ gro/ dūr+wa/ ku sha rnams dwangs shing thogs pa med pa ngo bo bzang zhing rgya che ba/ tshe thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i nad gdon sdig sgrib sogs spang bya ma lus pa zhi ba'i nus pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang ldan par gyur/ oṃ bo dhi bṛk+ṣa ye swā hā/ oṃ ag+na ye swā hā/ oṃ sarba pā pam̐ da ha na badz+ra ye swā hā/ oṃ ma da na pañca a mṛ ta āḥhūm̐/ oṃ ba la pañca a mṛ ta āḥhūm̐/ oṃ sarba saṃ bo de swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+ṭa ye swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra bi dza ye swā hā/ oṃ mahā be ga ye swā hā/ oṃ mahā ba la ye swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra ghasma ri ye swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra ā yu ṣe swā hā/ oṃ a pra ti ha ta badz+ra ye swā hā/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis byin gyis brlabs la/ thab nang mchod dang sum+bha nis bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las hūm̐ las thab khung chos 'byung gru gsum kha dog dmar po kha khyer la gri gug mu ran la rdo rje'i phreng ba/ zur rnams la zla phyed rdo rjes mtshan pa dwangs shing thogs pa med pa/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ thab kyi dbus su/ pam̐ las pad+ma/ ram̐ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su ram̐ las me lha sku mdog dmar po zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa/ phyag g.yas kyi dang pos mchog sbyin/ gnyis pas bgrang 'phreng*/ g.yon gyi dang pos dbyug gu gsum pa/ gnyis pas bdud rtsis gang ba'i ghan+dhe 'dzin pa/ ral pa'i thor tshugs dang ldan pa/ tshangs pa'i skud pa dang*/ kṛṣ+ṇa sa ri'i pags pa'i stod g.yogs can/ dar dmar po'i sham thabs bsnams pa/ me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐ dmigs nas de'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ dang*/ rang gi snying ga'i hūm̐ gi sa bon las 'od 'phros pas shar lho nas me lha spyan drangs par bsam zhing*/ lag g.yas pas mi 'jigs pa'i phyag rgya bcas la/ mthe bong srin lag gi rtsa bar bkug pa spyan drangs pa'i tshul du bya zhing*/

tshur byon tshur byon 'byung po che// me lha'i rgyal po drang srong mchog /bsreg blugs zhal zas bzhes slad du// 'di nyid du ni bzhugs su gsol// oṃ e h+ye hi mahā bhu ta dā+e ba ri ṣi di dzaḥ sa twa ma gṛ hi s+t+waṃ a nu re ma hā rasmi sin+ni hi twa bha wa/ oṃ ag+na ye e h+ye hi/ zhes brjod nas/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hosaḥganyis su med par thim/ de nas yang 'od 'phros pas/ sangs rgyas rigs lnga spyan drangs nas mchod la/ 'di la dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyis/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐/ zhes gsungs shing dbang bskur/ sku gang*/ dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las rnam par snang mdzad kyis dbu brgyan par bsam/ me lha mchod pa'i phyir nang mchod/ sum+bha nis bsang ba'i ku sha'i chun po brgyad/ phyogs dang mtshams su rim pa dang*/ rim pa las bzlos par dgram zhing*/ ku sha 'di ni gtsang zhing dge /sa las skyes pa'i snying po mchog /dkon mchog gsum gyi dag byed de// tshangs pa yi yang dag byed yin// des bdag la bgegs med par mdzod cig /ma ma shīn+taṃ kurban swā hā/ me lha'i lce hūm̐ las rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa la ram̐/ dgang blugs gzar bu'i kha la ram̐ bsams te gzar bu blangs/ rig byed 'don pa ltar tsog pur 'dug ste pus mo gnyis kyi bar du gru mo gnyis tshud par byas la/ oṃ ag+na ye swā hā zhes brjod cing*/ blugs gzar lan bdun gyis dgang gzar bkang la/ oṃ ag+na ye a dī bya a dī bya/ a bi sha a bi sha/ ma hā shri ye/ ha bya ka bya ba hā na ye swā hā/ zhes brjod de gzar bu gnyis kha sbyar la/ me lha'i zhal du phul bar bsam/ de lta bu'i dgang blugs bdun pa lan gsum phul/ oṃ ag+na ye zhes kun la sbyar la ar+ghaṃ nas shab+da'i bar bya/ oṃ ag+na ye oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis nang bdud rtsis mchod/ 'jig rten dbang phyug tshangs dbang mgon gyi sras// me lha'i rgyal po ḍā kis dbang bskur ba// shes rab mchog gis nyon mongs thams cad sreg

/'jigs byed me lha nyid la rnam par 'dug /ces brjod/ 'bar ba'i me la yam shing*/ mar chang zhal du/ gzhan gong bu thams cad phyag tu phul/ dūr+wa ku sha spyi gtsug tu phul bar bsams la/ re re dbul ba'i thog mar/ sum+bha nis bsang la/ sngags thams cad kyi thog mar/ oṃ ag+na ye zhes sbyar la/ rdzas rang rang gi sngags kyis phul te/ thog mar spel tshig can nyi shu rtsa gcig dbul te/ oṃ bo dhi bṛk+ṣa ya bdag cag yon mchod thams cad kyi sdig sgrib nad gdon mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad shīn+taṃ ku ru swā hā/ thog mar gcig oṃ ag+na ye bho dhi bṛk+ṣa ya swā hā/ bar du/ mthar sngar smos pa'i spel tshig can gyi mjug tu gcig ste nyi shu rtsa gcig de bzhin du mar dang chang dgang gzar blugs gzar gyis phul/ sha dum nyi shu rtsa gcig re/ til brgya tham pa/ zas mchog 'bras/ so ba/ nas/ sran ma/ dūr+wa ku sha nyi shu rtsa gcig re phul/ oṃ ag+na ye ar+ghaṃ nas/ 'jigs byed me lha nyid la rnam par 'dud// ces pa gong bzhin mchod bstod/ oṃ ag+na ye dz+wa la ram̐/ zhes brjod pas me lha 'bar ba'i rnam par gyur/ me'i dbus su zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su bam̐/ mtha' bskor du oṃ oṃ oṃ sogs nas mngon rtogs bzhin me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ dmigs med mkha' ltar dag cing khyab pa yi// chos dbyings nam mkha' bzhin du dbyer med kyang*// thabs dang shes rab gzugs brnyan skur ston pa// bcom ldan 'khor bcas 'dir ni gshegs su gsol// oṃ e h+ye hi sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra yo gi ni zhes spyan drangs nas/ ar+ghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par thim pa nas dbu brgyan pa'i bar byas la/ byon zan mar bdun tshan gsum dbul ba gong dang 'dra/ de la phyi mchod dang*/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra yo gi ar+ghaṃ nas gaṇ+ḍe ra ṇi sogs/ oṃ gsum mas nang mchod dbul/ gang gi drin gyis bde chen nyid nas/

de snyed rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// rdzas re re la'ang oṃ gsum ma re res byin gyis brlabs la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra yo gi oṃ bo d+dhi bṛk+ṣa ya bdag gzhan thams cad kyi sdig sgrib mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad shīn+taṃ ku ru ye swā hā/ zhes sogs thog mthar spel tshig yod pa/ bar du spel tshig med pa brgya phrag re dang*/ sha chang gnyis oṃ gsum mas dbul/ mjug tu oṃ ma da na mṛ ta āḥhūm̐ bdag cag yon mchod sogs spel tshig gi mjug tu/ de bzhin du sha yang dbul/ til sum brgya tsam phul/ gzhan thams cad brgya phrag re re dbul/ thams cad kyi mjug tu mar bdun gyis rjes la/ oṃ ag+na ye a dī bya a dī bya a bhi sha a bhi sha ma hā shrī ye/ ha bya ka bya ba ha na ya bdag cag yon mchod 'khor dang bcas pa dang sems can thams cad kyi tshe 'khor ba thog mtha' med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig pa dang sgrib pa/ nad dang gdon thams cad dang skal ba ngan pa/ rmi lam ngan pa sogs spang bya mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad shīn+taṃ ku ru ye swā hā/ yang de lta bu bdun phrag gsum dbul/ phyi nang gi mchod pa dang bstod pa sngar bzhin byas la yi ge brgya pa'i mthar/ bzod par gsol ba dang dngos grub blang ba rnams mngon rtogs bzhin byas la/ oṃ badz+ra muḥ ye shes pa gshegs/ thabs kyi dbus nas rdul cung zad blangs la/ smin mtshams su byugs/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ dam tshig pa bdag la thim/ mar blugs gzar gang thab tu blugs la/ oṃ ag+na ye dz+wa la ram̐/ me lha zhal gcig phyag bzhi dang ldan pa'i rnam par gyur/ bsreg rdzas rnams gong gi rim bzhin du/ nyi shu rtsa gcig re phul ba'i mtha' mar blugs gzar bdun tshan gsum spel tshig dang bcas pa phul ba'i mthar/ oṃ ag+na ye ar+ghaṃ swā hā sogs phyi'i mchod pa dang*/ oṃ ag+na ye oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis nang mchod kyis mchod/ gtor ma bsang sbyangs byas la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hos byin gyis brlabs/

oṃ ag+na ye na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta bh+yoḥbi shwa mu ṣe bh+yaḥ sarba thā khaṃ ut+ga te s+pha ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ gṛh+ne daṃ ba liṃ te swā hā/ zhes gsum mam bdun gyis phul nas/ rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ tshangs dbang 'jig rten mgon gyi sras// me lha'i rgyal po drang srong mchog /'byung po yongs su bskyab pa'i phyir// thugs rje'i dbang gi skur sprul pa// rig sngags grub pa'i drang srong tshul// nyon mongs bsreg pa'i shes rab 'od// bskal pa'i me ltar gzi brjid 'bar// mngon shes rdzu 'phrul zhabs dang ldan// thabs kyi sprul pa'i theg pa chibs// rig sngags gsung gi bgrang phreng 'dzin// nyes pa'i skyon bral tshangs par spyod// bdud rtsi'i rgyun gyi ghan+dhe bsnams// chos kyi bdud rtsi yongs la bsil// 'jig rten gnas kyang mya ngan 'das// zhi ba mnyes kyang thugs rje che// de la bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal// shes rab chen pos bdag med thugs chud cing*// thugs rje chen pos 'gro ba kun sgrol yang*// thabs la mkhas pas drang srong cha lugs 'dzin// 'dzin byed me lha nyid la phyag 'tshal lo// gzi brjid chen po me yi lha// 'dod pa thams cad sgrub pa po// bdag gzhan don sbyor sa la bzhugs// tshangs sras mchog la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes pas bstod/ bdag cag yon mchod kyis thog drangs sems can thams cad kyi sdig pa dang sgrib pa nad gdon bar chad mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad dang*/ cho ga lhag chad du gyur pa'i nyes pa ltung ba thams cad zhi ba'i dngos grub stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab la/ spyan 'dren pa'i phyag rgya phyir bskyed se gol gtogs cing*/ oṃ ag+na ye dza hi dza hi swa ar+than rtse/ wa sa ra ar+than rtse/ swa dhi taṃ gats+tsha ha bya bhu ka a ṣa mi ṣ+ya si ya tha ka le/ zhes pas gshegs su gsol/ dam tshig pa bdag la bsdus/ thab kyi dbus nas thal ba cung zad blangs la/ smin mtshams su bskus nas bkra shis kyi tshig brjod do// 'dir zhi ba bstan pa yin/

rgyas pa dang*/ dbang dang*/ drag po rnams thab khung 'di nyid las mi 'gyur la/ bud shing*/ sgrub pa po/ chas gos/ 'dug stangs/ bsam pa/ bsreg rdzas grangs/ sngags kyi mtha' rten spel tshig dus la sogs cung zad mi 'dra ba rnams gsung rab du ma nas yang yang 'byung bas/ des 'dir yang shes pas ma smos/ 'di ni mchog thun mong gi dngos grub 'grub par gsungs so// gnyis pa mar me'i sbyin sreg byed par 'dod na/ mar me'i kong bu yangs par ras dmar po'i sdong bu btsugs la/ mar dkar po ji tsam 'tshams pa blugs/ 'byor na mchod pa lnga dang*/ gtor ma bshams/ ma 'byor na yid kyis bsam pas btub/ gang ltar yang bdag gi rnal 'byor bzlas pa dang bcas pa byas la/ mchod rdzas bsang sbyangs byin gyis brlabs/ bsreg rdzas kyi til bsangs sbyangs/ hūm̐ las byung ba'i til gyi phung por gyur pa las/ bdag gi tshe thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i las kyi sgrib pa thams cad snying ga'i bam̐ las kaṃ nag po brgyud mar byon te/ sna sgor slebs pa dang sdig pa rwa can gyi gzugs su gyur nas mdun gyi til la thim pas/ bdag gi sdig sgrib dag nges snyam par bsgom zhing*/ ngag tu oṃ gsum ma bzlas/ de 'dra ba lan 'ga' zhig bya/ de nas mar me spar la/ mchod pas mchod la bstod/ rje btsun ma'i zhal du sdig pa'i gzugs phul bar bsam zhing*/ ldug rtsa na oṃ gsum ma'i mjug tu/ oṃ sarba pā paṃ shīn+taṃ ku ru ye swā hā/ zhes pa brgya'am stong la sogs pa ji tsam grub pa byas pa'i mthar/ mchod bstod gtor ma yod na dbul/ bstod pa bya/ nongs pa bzod par gsol/ 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba gdab/ badz+ra muḥye shes pa gshegs/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥdam tshig pa bdag la thim pa'i mos pa byas/ sdig pa 'dag par byed pa'i mchog yin gsung ngo*// ༈ /gsum pa sdig pa dang*/ dam tshig nyams pa thams cad bskang ba'i phyir yi ge brgya pa la brten nas sbyin sreg bsdus pa bya bar 'dod pas/

rdza gsar pa'i thab chung ci rigs pa bya ste/ de sol ba gang yang rung bas bkang nas bdag gi mdun du bzhag bdag gi rnal 'byor bsgom pa nas bzung ste thams cad mar me'i sbyin sreg gi dmigs pa dang 'dra ba las/ bdag bskyed kyi oṃ gsum ma'i mjug tu yi ge brgya pa cung zad bzlas pa dang*/ til byin gyis brlabs pa'i dus su yang oṃ gsum ma'i don du yi ge brgya pa bzlas/ thabs kyi dbus su rje btsun ma'i dod du/ pad+ma nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su hūm̐ las rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las/ za byed rdo rje mkha' 'gro nag po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas rdo rje/ g.yon dril bu'am/ thod pa gang yang rung ba gdengs pa'i tshul gyis 'dzin pa/ rngam pa'i gzugs can rgyan med pa/ zhabs g.yas bskum/ g.yon brkyang bas me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'i sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlabs/ ye shes pa gzhug pa/ dbang bskur mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan pa la mchod bstod/ de nyid lhag pa'i lhar nges pa brtan po bya/ de'i thugs kar nyi ma la gnas pa'i hūm̐ de/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i thugs yang dag pa'i ye shes yin par bsams la/ lag pa gnyis kyi mtheb srin gyis til lam/ yungs kar gang yang rung ba bzung la/ za byed rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i zhal du sdig pa'i gzugs phul bar bsam zhing lhugs/ sngags ni/ oṃ badz+ra ḍā ki kha kha khā hi khā hi/ sarba pā paṃ da ha na bhasmin ku ru ye swā hā/ zhes pa thun re la nyi shu rtsa gcig nas stong rtsa brgyad kyi bar du bya'o// rjes thams cad gong dang mtshungs so// 'di la rtags myur du 'byung ste/ sna khrag 'dzag pa 'khru ba dang*/ khrus byed pa dang*/ gos gsar pa gyon pa dang*/ mi sha za ba dang*/ nam mkha' la 'phur ba sogs rmi ba 'byung ngo*// 'phral du yang lus bde ba dang*/ sems dga' ba 'byung ngo*// sbyin sreg 'di ni rang don du ma zad kyi gzhan sdig pa 'dag par 'dod pa gsol ba 'debs pa yang mdun du bzhag la/

snying ga'i hūm̐ las kaṃ bton pa la sogs pa ji lta ba bzhin byas nas de bskor te bsreg na yang*/ de'i sdig pa zad par 'gyur ro// 'di yang shin tu dben par bya ste rdo rje mkha' 'gro las 'byung ngo gsung*/ bzhi pa khrus ni/ bum pa ji lta ba bzhin bshams/ sum+bha ni bzlas shing*/ gu gul gyis bdug yungs kar gyis brdeg sman lnga/ 'bru lnga/ rin po che lnga gzhug dri zhim po'i chus bkang*/ kha rgyan dbul zhing stegs la sogs pa gtsang mar bzhag grub na mchod pa bdun dang gtor ma gcig bshams/ ma grub na yid kyis chog de nas lha'i rnal 'byor rdzogs par bsgoms la/ oṃ gyis stong par bsgom/ de'i ngang las pad nyi'i steng du bum pa ji lta ba bzhin bskyed/ de'i nang du ā li kā li gnyis g.yon skor las zla ba la me long*/ g.yas skor du kā li gnyis las nyi ma mnyam pa nyid/ bar du so sor rtog pa/ kha sbyor bya ba nan tan/ de rnams yongs su gyur pa las bde mchog gi dkyil 'khor rdzogs par bskyed pa chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes so// yang na gtso bo tsam bskyed do// de nas bum pa'i mgrin par ā li las zla ba/ de'i steng du hūm̐/ de'i mtha' mar he ru ka'i yi ge brgya pa mu tig gi rdog ma lta bu g.yon skor/ de nas lha dang sngags phreng la mchod pas mchod/ dam tshig can la gtor ma byin/ de nas bum steng gi gzungs thag blangs la dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma'i thugs ka nas yi ge brgya pa'i sngags dung dang*/ kun+da ltar dkar ba dpag tu med pa byon te/ bum pa'i mgul pa'i sngags phreng la thim/ de bum pa'i nang gi lha la thim pas/ ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgyun 'dzag ste bum pa gang bar bsam zhing*/ sngags brgya rtsa brgyad la sogs pa bzla'o// mthar mchod pa mi dgos/ sngags phreng dang bum pa'i lha 'od du zhu ba'i chur bsam/ de nas bdag la sogs pas chu hub gsum gsum btung zhing*/ snod gtsang mar gdong bkru ba la sogs pa bya'o// de 'dra ci tsam 'dod pa'i bar du bsgrubs nas/

mthar chu la bstim pa'i ye shes pa la nongs pa bzod par gsol nas/ ye shes pa gshegs su gsol/ 'di'i phan yon ni sdig pa 'dag dam tshig nyams chag skong*/ bsam gtan gyi bar chad la sogs pa thams cad dag par 'gyur zhes gsungs te khrus kyi cho ga'o// ༈ /'khrul 'khor byed na/ gro ga la sogs pa la rtsibs drug pa lte ba dang mu khyud gnyis rim dang bcas pa bri/ lte ba la rin chen bzhi gang yang rung ba gsung mod dpa' bo'i go cha dang*/ dpa' mo'i go cha'i mthar che ge mo la gnod par byed pa rnams phyir bzlog cig ces/ de'i mu khyud la ā li g.yon skor/ rtsibs rnams la yi ge brgya pa bcu drug bcad la 'god/ de'i mu khyud la kā li g.yas skor du bkod la/ rab tu gnas pa ji ltar gzhan las 'byung ba bzhin bya gsung yang*/ ye shes pa thams cad go cha'i lha tshogs su byas pa dpag tu med pa gzhan 'dra'o// de dpung pa la sogs pa la btags te/ yi ge brgya pa bzlas na phyir bzlog gi mchog yin no// 'khrul 'khor gyi cho ga'o// de las gzhan pa'i las sna tshogs gnod sbyin mo'i sgrub pa la sogs pa rnams ni 'dir ma smos te/ bla ma dam pa'i gsung rab rnams las rtogs par 'gyur ba'i phyir ro// dus thams cad du mkho ba tshes bcu'i mchod pa yi dam du byed na/ bsod nams 'phel bar 'dod na yar ngo'i tshes bcu/ sdig pa 'dag par 'dod na mar ngo'i tshes bcu la gnas khang dben zhing ma dag pa thams cad sbyangs nas/ legs par brgyan par 'byor na sin+dhu ra'i maṇ+ḍal/ de med na tsan+dan dmar po/ de'ang med na chang gi maṇ+ḍal dang*/ mchod pa dang*/ gtor ma la sogs sngar smos pa lta bu la/ sa la 'bri ba dang ka pā la mi dgos/ bdag bskyed dang mdun bskyed mchod pa dang*/ bstod pa la sogs pa tshul ji lta ba bzhin byas la/ dam tshig gi nyes ltung thams cad bshags shing*/ bdag gzhan gyi bsod nams spel ba'i don du shes rab kyi sgor zhugs pa'i rgyun bshags tshar gsum/

yan lag bdun pa dang*/ dam tshig gi nyes ltung bshags pa dang*/ rigs lnga spyi dang khyad par gyi sdom pa bzung ba/ khyad par gyi dam tshig bzung ba rnams lan gsum gsum byas pas/ dam tshig dang sdom pa thams cad sor chud pa'i nges shes bskyed/ gtor ma btang ba dang*/ tshogs la longs spyod pa la sogs pa sngar smos pa dang 'dra/ de ma grub na bu mo grong pa'i chos kyis ma gos pa gsum mam lnga bza' btung gis tshim par bya'o// gang ltar yang gang zag thams cad thugs dgongs mthun par gnas pa ni gtso bo yin no// de'ang ma grub na/ snying po brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas nyams pa thams cad 'dag ces gsungs/ 'di thams cad la bla ma tshad mar 'dzin pa dang*/ bdag nyid la tshad mar 'dzin pa ni nges par dgos so// zhes gsungs so// gzhan zhal 'ba' zhig la brgyud pa'i gdams pa ni/ bri bar ma gnang bas 'dir ma bris la/ 'di ni bskyed pa'i rim pa nā ro mkha' spyod ces bya ba yin no// yang dag grub pa nā ro ta pa'i gsung*// dri med 'dzin pa dpal ldan sa skya pa// dam pa dam pa kho na las brgyud pa'i// gsang chen sbas pa'i man ngag gsal byas pa'i// dge ba 'di yis byang chub snying po'i bar// dpal ldan bla ma mchog gi rjes 'brangs pa// lam gyi mi mthun phyogs rnams rab spangs te// bla na med pa'i go 'phang thob par shog /rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i chos skor bla ma gong ma rnams kyis thor bu gnas pa phyogs gcig tu rtogs sla ba'i phyir/ man ngag rin po che'i gter zhes bya ba 'di/ mdo khams kyi sa'i cha/ tsha 'brang pa rin chen bzang pos yang yang bskul ba'i ngor/ rig pa 'dzin pa gzungs kyi dpal bzang pos/ lug gi lo sa ga zla ba'i yar tshes bcu bzhi'i nyin dpal sa skyar sbyar ba'o// dge legs su gyur cig 'dis 'gro ba dpag tu med pa la phan thogs par gyur cig/ ༈ /

nā ro mkha' spyod kyi thun mong ma yin pa'i rtsa dbu ma'i khrid yig rje mus chen gyis mdzad pa bzhugs so// ༈ /gu ru shrī badz+ra yo gi nī/ bla ma dang dpal rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la phyag 'tshal lo// zab yang rgyud rgyal gsang mtha'i don// gsal mdzad grub pa'i dbang phyug dang*// lam bzang rgyas mdzad sa skya pa// mkhas grub bla ma'i zhabs la 'dud// mkha' spyod nye lam zab mo'i gnad// myur mgyogs bgrod pa'i nye lam mchog /bla ma'i gsung bzhin rang nyid kyi// dran pa gsal phyir bri bar bya// 'dir dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi bgrod pa gcig pa'i lam/ dpal 'khor lo bde mchog rtsa dbu ma'i rgyud kyi rgyal po chen po/ rnal 'byor gsang mtha'i dgongs pa/ grub chen nā ro pa'i man ngag rje btsun rnal 'byor dbang phyug dpal sa skya pa la babs pa'i rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i chos skor 'di la/ bskyed pa'i rim pa nā ro mkha' spyod/ rdzogs pa'i rim pa rtsa dbu ma/ lam gyi cha rkyen sman chen po'i bcud len/ gnod sbyin mo dbang du bya ba/ pra sen dbab pa rnams yod pa las 'dir rdzogs rim gyi sgo nas gdul bya yang dag pa'i lam du khrid par byed pa yin/ de yang rtsa rgyud kyi le'u dang po las/ pho nya mchog 'bring tha ma rnams// zhes pa la brten nas pho nya mchog rtsa dbu ma mchod pa'i gdams ngag 'di sgom par byed pa la/ thog mar dpal 'khor lo bde mchog rnal 'byor gsang mtha'i lugs kyi dkyil 'khor gang rung du dbang bskur ba thob cing*/ dam tshig dang sdom par ldan pa'i gang zag gis/ 'di'i byin rlabs kyi sgo dbye nas/ rdzogs rim bsgom pa la sngon 'gro dang*/ dngos gnyis las/ dang po la/ lam log pa las khyad par du bya ba skyabs 'gro'i khrid/ nyan rang las khyad par du bya ba sems bskyed khrid/ 'gal rkyen sdig sgrib sbyang ba yi ge brgya pa'i khrid/ mthun rkyen bsod nams gsog pa maṇ+ḍal gyi khrid/

byin rlabs myur du 'jug pa bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi khrid rnams yod pa las/ dang po ni/ mthun rkyen 'dzom zhing gnas dben par bsam gtan gyi spyod lam dang ldan pas/ mdun gyi nam mkhar seṅge brgyad kyis btegs pa'i rin po che'i khri'i steng du/ drin chen rtsa ba'i bla ma de nyid rdo rje chos sku mdog dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas bde stong gi sgra sgrogs pa'i ḍā ma ru 'khrol ba/ g.yon par bdud rtsis gang ba'i thod pa thugs kar bsnams pa/ gru mo na kha ṭ+wāṃ ga 'dzin pa/ rus pa'i rgyan drug gis brgyan pa/ zhabs rdo rje skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ de'i sku la sangs rgyas rigs lnga sogs bzhugs pa sangs rgyas dkon mchog thugs rgyud lung rtogs kyis bsdus pa'i chos rnams chos dkon mchog skye mched tshigs sogs la byang chub sems dpa' dang khro bo bzhugs pa dge 'dun dkon mchog de skad du yang bla ma sangs rgyas bla ma chos// de bzhin bla ma dge 'dun te// kun gyi byed po bla ma yin// zhes gsungs pas/ bla ma de dkon mchog gsum gyi ngo bor bsgoms la/ rang la drin che ba'i pha g.yas/ ma g.yon du/ spun zla ming sring sogs mtha' skor du/ gzhan yang sems can thams cad kyis bskor nas/ de thams cad kyis mgrin gcig tu/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams la= dam pa'i chos= 'phags pa'i dge 'dun= zhes yid rtse gcig tu brgya'am stong gi bar du blo 'dres nges par bya'o// gnyis pa ni/ 'gro rnams bsgral 'dod bsam pa yis// sogs gong ltar bya'o// bzhi pa ni/ lnga pa bla ma'i rnal 'byor dang phyogs gcig tu mdzad do// sngar gyi skyabs 'gro'i yul de nyid spyi bor bsgom pa la/ bla ma de'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas/ brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams spyan drangs te de la thim par bsams te/ yid rtse gcig tu/ dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// zhes ci nus kyis gsol ba btab ste/

de nas maṇ+ḍal tshom bu bdun pa ci 'grub 'bul/ de nas bla ma'i gnas gsum du yi ge dkar dmar mthing gsum bkod/ de nas bla ma'i dpral ba'i oṃ las 'od zer dkar po byung*/ rang gi dpral bar thim/ lus kyi sgrib pa dag sku'i byin rlabs zhugs/ bum pa'i dbang thob/ mgrin pa'i āḥlas 'od zer dmar po byung*/ rang gi mgrin par= ngag gi= gsung gi= gsang ba'i= thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer sngon po byung*/ rang gi snying gar= yid kyi= thugs kyi= shes rab ye shes kyi= gnas gsum nas 'od zer byung*/ rang gi gnas gsum du thim/ lus ngag yid gsum gyi sdig sgrib dag bla ma'i sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs zhugs/ dbang bzhi pa thob par bsam/ mthar bla ma 'od du zhu nas rang la thim pas/ rang gi snying gar chos 'byung dmar po nyis brtsegs kyi lte bar bam̐/ grwa drug la dga' ba 'khyil pa re bsgom/ gnyis pa dngos gzhi la gnyis/ rgyu bskyed pa'i rim pa/ 'bras bu rdzogs pa'i rim pa'o// dang po la gsum/ rim gyis gsal btab pa dang*/ nga rgyal la bslab pa dang*/ sems 'dzin pa dngos gnyis/ dang po ni/ snying ga'i chos 'byung gi nang gi bam̐ de phru ma phus btab pa bzhin je che la song nas/ mthar yangs shing rgya che ba cig bsgom/ de ni rgyud gzhan du swa bhā wa gsungs pa'i don yin no gsungs/ de nas de'i nang du rang rnam par shes pa'i bam̐ yig yongs su gyur pa las pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan gyi steng du rang nyid rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma sku mdog pad+ma rā ga ltar dmar zhing*/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyi g.yas rdo rjes mtshan pa'i gri gug 'jol thabs su 'dzin pa g.yon thod pa khrag gis gang ba bsnams pa/ zhal g.yon gyis gyen phyogs la gzigs shing*/ spyan gsum mkha' spyod du gzigs pa/ phrag pa g.yon par rdo rjes mtshan pa'i kha ṭ+wāṃ ga la ḍā ma ru dang*/ dril bu 'phyang bzhin pa bsnams pa/ dbu skra nag po sil bur gyur pa/

thod pa skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang*/ skam po lnga bcu'i do shal can/ phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa/ zhabs g.yas brkyangs pas dus mtshan ma dmar mo dang*/ g.yon bskums pas 'jigs byed nag po mnan pa/ ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o// de'i gnas rnams su zla ba'i gdan la/ lte bar oṃ bam̐ dmar mo rdo rje phag mo/ snying gar ham̐ yoṃ sngon mo gshin rje ma/ khar hriṃ moṃ dkar mo rmongs byed ma/ dpral bar hriṃ hriṃ ser mo skyod byed ma/ spyi gtsug tu hūm̐ hūm̐ ljang gu skrag byed ma/ yan lag thams cad la phaṭa phaṭa dud kha tsaṇ+ḍi ka'i ngo bo/ thugs ka'i bam̐ yig las 'od 'phros pas/ 'og min nas rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma thams cad kyis bskor ba/ phaiṃ zhes pas spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hosaḥganyis su med pa thim/ oṃ yo ga shud+dhaḥsarba dharmāḥyo ga shud+dho3haṃ/ bzlas pa ni/ snying ga'i bam̐ yig la sngags kyis bskor ba las 'od 'phros/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi byin rlabs dang yon tan 'od zer dmar po'i rnam par spyan drangs/ sngags phreng la thim pas bdag gi sdig sgrib dag cing yon tan rgyas par bsam/ sngags ci nus bzlas so// deṃ yaṃng lha'i de yang gser sku ltar hreng hreng po ma yin pa/ lder sku ltar lder lder po min pa/ snang la rang bzhin med pa me long nang gi gzugs brnyan dang mtshungs pa/ skyon kun zad yon tan kun rdzogs pa'i skur bsgom mo// 'dis ni bdag tu 'dzin pa'i rnam par rtog pa 'joms par byed pa'o// gnyis pa ni/ sangs rgyas nga rgyal rnal 'byor gyis// sangs rgyas nyid du bsgrub par bya// zhes gong ltar rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma skyon kun zad/ yon tan kun rdzogs te nga'o snyam pa'i nga rgyal yang yang bskyed la/ 'di ni bdag tu 'dzin pa'i rnam rtog 'joms par byed pa'o// gnyis pa ni/

rgyan med la sems 'dzin pa dang*/ rgyan can la sems 'dzin pa'o// dang po ni/ rang rje btsun mar gsal ba'i dpral ba/ mdzod spur spyan dbus ma dmar rtsa shig ge ba bsgom/ ngag tu spyan dbus ma dmar rtsa shig ge ba zhes brjod la bsgom/ 'di la yun ring du bsgom mo// de grub pa dang gzhan grub sla bas spyan g.yas g.yon/ shangs/ zhal gyi ngos mche ba cung zad gtsigs pa/ de nas zhal byings/ snyan g.yas g.yon/ dbu ril po dbu skra dang bcas pa la/ mgrin pa/ sku stod/ phyag g.yas pa thur du 'phyang bas rdo rjes mtshan pa'i gri gug dang bcas pa la/ g.yon thod pa khrag gis gang ba phrag pa'i steng du 'dzin pa/ nu 'bur rgyas pa la/ sku smad/ brla g.yas/ zhabs ngar/ zhabs mgo zhabs g.yas brkyang bas dus mtshan ma mnan pa la/ de bzhin du zhabs g.yon gyi brla nas bskum pas 'jigs byed mnan pa/ gdan gyi pad nyi'i bar rim bzhin bsgom/ de ltar bsgoms pas rtsa gnas/ de gnas pas rlung gnas/ des byang chub kyi sems gnas/ des mi rtog pa'i ting nge 'dzin skye ba yin gsungs so// gnyis pa ni/ spyi bo'i rus 'khor la sems 'dzin/ de nas rigs lnga'i dbu rgyan la/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu brgyan la/ rus pa'i rna rgyan la/ rus pa'i mgul rgyan la/ dpung gdub phyag gdub gnyis la/ mi mgo skam po'i do shal la/ rus pa'i ske rags/ rkang gdub gnyis la rim pa bzhin 'dzin no// 'di rnams kyi dmigs pa ni zhag bdun bdun la nges par spo ba gsungs so// 'di nyid rgyun du chags med byed pa ni/ mngon rtogs bsgoms bzlas rnams byas nas/ nga rgyal dang sems 'dzin cung zad re byas la/ de nas rdzogs rim sgom gsungs/ gnyis pa rdzogs pa'i rim pa bsgom pa la gsum/ gzhi 'khor ba'i gnad/ lam sgom pa'i gnad/ 'bras bu sangs rgyas kyi sa bshad pa'o// dang po ni/ pha ma gnyis kyi 'du 'phrod las byung ba'i lus grub tshul de'i rtsa 'khor bzhi'i chags tshul lo// gnyis pa la dpe gsum gyi sgo nas bstan te/

bshan pa srog gi gnad la mkhas pa/ shing mkhan shing gi gnad la mkhas pa/ sgyu ma mkhan 'khrul 'khor gyi gnad la mkhas pa/ rnal 'byor pa lam gyi gnad la mkhas pa'o// de la rdzogs rim bsgom pa ni/ bskyed rim gyi man ngag ltar bya/ de nas lus skyil krung sgal tshigs bsrang la/ de nas rnal 'byor dngos la 'jug par bya'o// lus la rtsa dpag tu med kyang rtsa sum cu rtsa gnyis su 'dus so// de dag kyang rtsa gsum du 'dus so// de'ang lte ba'i 'og nas rtsa 'og rlung gi 'khor los drod 'byung*/ bar sngags kyi 'khor los bde ba 'byung*/ steng mkha' spyod kyi 'khor los mi rtog pa 'byung*/ nang rtsa'i dbyibs gru gsum stong pa rlung gi gzhal yas khang bde gsal mi rtog pa gsum mngon du skye bar byed/ rtags lnga dang yon tan 'byung*/ gsum so sor gyes te lte bar 'dus pas rdo rje'i rnam pa lta bu'o// de ltar rtsa gsum dmigs la steng 'og rlung kha sbyar te/ lte ba'am de las mtho tsam me 'bar bar bsam/ de nas lte ba'i cha gsum 'dus pa dros par bsam zhing*/ steng 'og gi rlung gnyis kyang lte bar kha sbyar/ des rlung dang byang sems thams cad lte bar 'dus nas a wa dhu tir 'jug par bsam/ gtum mo'i me ni lte bar sro ba tsam las rtsa dbu ma'i nang du 'gro ba'i dmigs pa mi bya/ de ltar bsgom pas lus la drod dang bde bas khyab cing*/ rtsa'i mdud pa gnyis bral te/ byang sems sum cu rtsa gnyis kyi spyi bo'i bar du gang bar bsam/ spyod lam gyi dus rlung gsum kha sbyar bar byas shing*/ mnyam gzhag gi dus su nyams myong skyes pa dran par bya ba'am/ sngar dbang gsum pa'i skabs su nyams myong skyes pa yod na de'i rgyun dran par bya'o// rlung dang byang sems thams cad dbu mar chud par 'gyur ro// yang phyag rgya chen po dbu mar 'jug pa la/ rlung lus la gnas par bya ba'i thabs ni/ rang gi mdzod spur chos kyi 'byung gnas dmar seng nge ba gcig bsam/

de'i nang du thig le kha dog sna tshogs pa gcig bsam/ de la shes pa gtad de bsgoms pas mdzod spur bde ba bskyed/ de nas rtsa dbu ma gro sog gi sbubs tsam gyi nang la yar thig le de song nas spyi gtsug nas mar 'khyog pa'i mtshams su thig le bzhag de la dmigs pa gtad/ der bde ba skyes pa dang*/ rtsa dbu ma'i nang nas mar ba rgya'i thag pa tsam du nar gyis song bas 'og sgo bde ba chen po'i lam gyi chos 'byung las kyang thal te/ phyir sor phyed dang bzhi tsam du nyug byung bas lan 'gas mi bzod pa'i bde ba skye'o// thig le 'dzag pa snyam byed na sor phri la sor gnyis bsgom/ des kyang mi bzod na ran tsam phri/ da rung mi bzod na phyir nyug tsam bya/ de ltar byas pas rlung lus la phog pa la sogs pa'i rkyen gang gis kyang bde ba skye bar 'gyur bas na/ rlung lus la gnas pa yin no// de nas rlung sems gnas gsang ba sems kyi dbyibs gnyug ma stong pa gzhal yas khang rlung sems yar mar gnyis drag tu bsgom/ des ni rtags lnga dang yon tan 'byung ste/ mchog thun mong gi dngos grub thob par 'gyur ro// par bya ba ni/ steng sgo rnam par gral ba'i lam gyi thig le rang la shes pa gtad pas ji zhig na lus med par bsam 'ja' tshon yin pa snyam byed na 'byung ste/ de ni rlung sems la gnas pa snang stong gnyis su med pa'i ye shes phyag rgya chen po'i gnas lugs 'char ram/ yin no// dpal nā ro ta pa'i man ngag dbu mar 'jug pa/ rje btsun rin po che grags pa rgyal mtshan gyis phyag chen gces bsdus na bzhugs pa ltar bris pa yin no// 'di ni mus pa chen po dkon mchog rgyal mtshan nas brgyud pa'o// ༈ / rje btsun nā ro mkha' spyod ma'i bskyed rdzogs kyi zin bris bzang dpal gyi brjed byang du byas pa bzhugs// ༈ /mkha' 'gro grangs med stong phrag bdun cu gnyis// brtson chen la sogs nyi shu bzhis bsdus la// de nyid lā ma la sogs drug cu 'dus// kun gyi bla ma rnal 'byor ma la 'dud// 'di don gsal ba'i gong ma'i gsung rab rnams// 'thor zhing bsdus pas dman pas rtogs mi nus// phyi rabs rnams kyi zin bris mang mod kyang*// gdams ngag ma rdzogs tshig 'bru tsam du sbas// mkha' 'gro'i gdams ngag zhal las brgyud pa yi// zab don yongs su rdzogs pa gsung bzhin bri// de la 'dir ma'i yang ma bla na med pa rnal 'byor gsang mtha'i rgyud kyi yang rtse nā ro mkha' spyod kyi khog sgrig ni/

sbyin bya bzhi/ bslab bya gnyis/ grogs spyod pa gnyis/ 'bras bu mchog thun mong gi dngos grub gnyis kyi sa bon theg pa gcig dgos te/ de ma thebs na gdams ngag gi snod du mi rung ba'i phyir/ sbyang bar nges pa ma byas par// skal min gsang ba ston pa dang*// zhes so// de'i sngon du yab kyi dkyil 'khor gang rung du dbang bzhi thob dgos te/ de ma thag pa la byin rlabs byas na ltung ba yin par rje btsun gyis bshad do// bslab bya gnyis la/ bskyed pa'i rim pa phag mo mkha' spyod/ rdzogs pa'i rim pa rtsa dbu ma/ lam gyi yan lag pra sen dbab pa/ sman chen po'i bcud len/ gnod sbyin mo dbang du bya ba dang lnga po 'di nā ro pa'i gdams ngag zab don rnams bsdus pa yin gyis/ lhan cig tu sbyor dgos pa ni min gsungs so// de la bskyed rim ni/ rtsa rgyud kyi le'u zhe bdun pa las/ mkha' 'gro ma'i rig pa chen mo bzlas na rigs thams cad dbang du 'gyur ro// rtag tu bzlas brjod byas na dpal chen po bskyed par 'gyur ro// zhes sogs kyi rnal 'byor ma'i sngags la brten nas mkha' spyod sgrub pa bstan te/ le'u so gnyis pa las/ rdo rje phag mo de yi ni// kha dog mtshon cha 'phyang la gzigs// zhes pas lha bstan/ 'di rnams kyi don phyogs gcig tu byas pa dpal nā ros mdzad pa'i gzhung 'di nyid yin no// 'di'i don nyams su len pa la rnal 'byor brgyad dngos bstan la yod la/ nyal ldang khrus gsum kha bskangs nas rnal 'byor bcu gcig gi gzhung sa chen gyis mdzad/ rje btsun gyi zhal gnyis ma'i sgrub thabs su/ nyal ldang khrus gsum bshad nas/ phag mo gang du 'di gsum ma tshang ba de 'dis kha bskang bar bya'o// zhes gsungs/ rtsa dbu ma 'di dngos bstan yab la sbyar kyang*/ bla ma phyi ma rnams kyis yum la sbyor bar bshad pas gnyis char gyi thun mong ba yin no// spyir gyi dbu ma la gdams ngag gces bsdus na bzhugs pa/

phyag chen gces bsdus na bzhugs pa la sogs pa mtha' yas pas gcig kho nar ma nges so// de lta bu'i rim gnyis zung 'jug nyams su len dgos te/ gsol 'debs las/ bden gnyis rnam dag rim gnyis dbu ma'i lam// sgrib gnyis sbyang phyir brtson pas legs bsgom pas// don gnyis lhun grub 'gyur med bde ba'i thugs// mkha' spyod thugs kyis byin gyis brlab tu gsol// zhes so// nyon sgrib tha mal gyi rnam rtog sbyang ba'i phyir bskyed rim dgos pa yin te/ gsol 'debs las/ tha mal snod bcud rab tu zhen pa yi// kun rdzob 'khrul pa'i las snang ma lus pa// rnam dag lha yi sku ru bsgyur byed pa'i// mkha' spyod bskyed rim bsgom par byin gyis rlobs// zhes so// bskyed rim de zab don mthar thug tu 'gro ba ni/ dbang bzhi'i don dang ldan pa yin te/ bstod pa las/ dbang bzhi'i don ldan bskyed rim zab mo'i lam// zhes so// shes sgrib gya nom lhar zhen gyi rnam rtog sbyong ba'i phyir rdzogs rim sgom par byed do// de lta bu'i bskyed rdzogs zung 'jug tu nyams su blangs pas/ rab phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub/ 'bring mkha' spyod dang rig pa 'dzin pa tshe 'di nyid la thob par byed/ don gyi gtso bo mkha' spyod nyid 'grub par byed do// de la mkha' spyod chen po sangs rgyas kyi sa yin la/ chung ngu ni 'ja' lus rdo rje'i sku lo bcu drug lon pa'i ngang tshul can/ longs spyod nam mkha' las 'byung ba sprul sku las chos dngos su gsan cing sprul sku'i zhing khams dpag tu med par rdzu 'phrul gyis 'gro nus la/ 'gro 'ong thams cad nam mkha' la byed pa tshe de la 'tshang rgya nges pa kho na yin no// rig 'dzin de las cung zhes pa'o// grogs spyod pa gnyis ni/ rang don dang gzhan don gnyis so// de lta bu'i lam nyams su len pa la/ sngon 'gro bsags sbyangs 'jug gsum dang*/

dngos gzhi khrid kyi rnal 'byor gnyis so// dang po bsags sbyangs 'jug gsum ni/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed sngon du btang nas/ srod kyi cha la sdig pa sbyang ba yig brgya'i rnal 'byor nyams su len pa ni ye shes kyi tshogs yin no// logs su ma byung na chag med mang du btang nas kyang don grub bo// tshogs gsog pa maṇ+ḍal dang*/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor gnyis phyogs gcig tu 'byung ste/ mdun gyi nam mkhar seṅges btegs pa'i rin po che'i khri yangs shing rgya che ba'i dbus su rtsa ba'i bla ma rdo rje chos 'og nas 'byung ba bzhin gsal btab/ mtha' bskor bka' ring brgyud nye brgyud kyi bla ma/ de'i mthar yul nyer bzhi'i dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma'i tshogs/ de'i mthar sangs rgyas dang byang sems/ de'i mthar nyan rang chos srung rnams gsal bar dmigs la/ gang gi drin gyis sogs phyag bya/ de nas brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs/ de nas phyi mchod byas nas maṇ+ḍal tshom bu bdun pa 'bul lo// bdun nam nyer gcig re/ de nas bdag gi rgyud la rim gnyis kyi ting nge 'dzin skye bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ tha mal gyi rnam rtog 'dag par= snod bcud lha ru gsal bar= gya nom lhar zhen 'dag par= snod bcud lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes su 'char bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes dang*/ mthar chos srung nyan rang dang bcas pa sangs rgyas byang sems la/ de dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma la/ de rtsa ba'i bla ma la bsdus/ rtsa ba'i bla ma la gus 'dud kyis gsol ba btab pas bla ma'i dpral ba'i oṃ las 'od zer dkar po byung*/ rang gi dpral bar oṃ/ lus thams cad skya mer gyis khengs/ lus kyi dri ma dag bla ma'i sku'i byin rlabs zhugs par bsam/ de bzhin du mgrin pa nas 'od zer dmar po byung ba sogs sbyar/ mthar bla ma 'od du zhu rang la thim pas bla ma'i sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las dang bcas pa 'di rang gi lus ngag yid gsum ro gcig tu 'dres pa'i ngang la rtse gcig tu mnyam par gzhag go
